explanation: Near 0 everywhere except at D2 when the agent chose a1 and reached S2 by a rare transition: then it is high, usually 9-10 in trials 30-60, and lower (4-7) late in the episode (trial 70 and after) or when the trial before was not a rare one, while a2 choices are always 0, whatever state they reach. The D2 of a common a1-to-S1 trial right after such a rare trial is 1; every D1 and GO step is 0.
